# Idealo.de Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/idealo-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/idealo-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product data from Idealo.de, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Code:** [`idealo.py`](idealo.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Manufacturer](results/manufacturer.json) · [Price history](results/price_history.json) · [Products](results/products.json) · [Search](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Idealo product pages for product and offer data
- Idealo search pages for listing data
- Idealo manufacturer pages for brand listings

## Functions

- `scrape_with_retry(config, _retries=0)` → `ScrapeApiResponse`: scrape a config and retry on any failure - idealo blocks requests intermittently
- `scrape_products(urls)` → `List[IdealoProduct]`: scrape product pages from idealo.de
- `scrape_search(query, max_pages=3)` → `List[IdealoListingItem]`: scrape search listings from idealo.de
- `scrape_manufacturer(url)` → `IdealoManufacturer`: scrape a manufacturer listing page from idealo.de
- `scrape_price_history(id, period, site_id=1)` → `IdealoPriceHistory`: scrape price history from idealo.de

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import idealo


async def main():
    price_history = await idealo.scrape_price_history(id="207643424", period="3M")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`IdealoOffer`**: `shop_name`, `shop_url?`, `shop_rating?`, `shop_rating_count?`, `price?`, `currency`, `delivery_info?`, `merchant_name?`, `url`
- **`IdealoProduct`**: `product_id?`, `name?`, `brand?`, `url`, `image?`, `description?`, `rating?`, `rating_count?`, `low_price?`, `high_price?`, `currency?`, `offer_count?`, `offers`
- **`IdealoListingItem`**: `product_id?`, `name?`, `url?`, `image?`, `price?`, `currency`, `offer_count?`, `shop_name?`
- **`IdealoManufacturer`**: `name?`, `description?`, `url`, `result_count?`, `products`
- **`IdealoPriceHistoryPoint`**: `date?`, `price?`
- **`IdealoPriceHistory`**: `product_id`, `period`, `currency`, `start_date?`, `avg_price?`, `lowest_price?`, `lowest_price_days?`, `highest_price?`, `highest_price_days?`, `points`

A field marked `?` can be `null`.

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`idealo.py`](idealo.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"DE"`: country of the proxy
- `render_js` = `True`: render the page in a real browser
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: proxy pool (datacenter or residential)

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/idealo-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_product_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`, `test_manufacturer_scraping`, `test_price_history_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
